betaDescription:
Scholarmancy helps families track grades, assignments, and class materials from school portals (Canvas, Skyward, Aeries).

What to try:
• Sign in as the demo parent (credentials in Beta App Review Information).
• Open the household dashboard, then Emma’s and Liam’s work.
• Student studio is a separate role — magic-link / student login, not this parent account.
• School portal passwords stay on the device. They are never sent to our servers.

Airplane mode: a signed-in session still opens. Live sync, login, and OAuth need a network connection and show “You’re offline” instead of hanging.
reviewNotes:
DEMO PARENT (required)
Email: demo@scholarmancy.com
Password: DemoPass123!

This is a seeded household: parent Sarah Mitchell with students Emma and Liam. After sign-in you land on the parent home (student list / dashboard). Do not expect a school-portal login on first launch — portal credentials are stored only on-device after the parent connects a source.

Student studio is a different account (emma.demo@scholarmancy.com) provisioned by the parent. Reviewers only need the parent demo.

Sign in with Apple / Google / Microsoft may appear if those provider apps are configured; email/password is sufficient for review.

Airplane mode: the app must not hang. Cold start restores a local session. Network calls time out in 15s with “You’re offline.”

Privacy: https://scholarmancy.com/privacy
Support: https://scholarmancy.com/support
Delete account: Settings → Delete account, or https://scholarmancy.com/delete-account
